messages:
rebecca-sec: Heads up - private-onprem tenant 'Orchid' lost audit forwarding after last night's netpol tighten. Locking thread.

mike-sre: seeing keystore-agent panics, logs show TLS handshake timeout then index/nil panics. Snapshotting logs.

ariane-devops: Netpol tightened at 02:10 UTC to only allow 10.23.4.0/24. Vendor rotated HSM to 10.23.5.77 at 02:05 UTC per vendor-bot. Likely blocked.

logan-audit: Audit stream stopped at 02:12 UTC. Creating immutable snapshot to s3://private-audit/Orchid/2026-05-03/. AU-2026-330 created.

rebecca-sec: Approve emergency egress expansion for 1h and ephemeral RBAC 'keystore-drain' for sec+oncall. Apply minimal netpol patch and rollback agent to last-known-good v1.4.2 if crashes persist.

ariane-devops: Applying netpol allow for 10.23.5.77/32 now. Rolling agent if needed.

kms-vendor-bot: Vendor note: during cert rollover some clients receive empty decrypts; recommend client change to treat empty responses as transient and return 503 instead of panic. KB: /kb/empty-decrypts

mike-sre: Mitigation done 02:28 UTC, audit resumed 02:29:11. Monitoring 1h.

rebecca-sec: Post-incident actions: (1) RFC for graceful decrypt handling, (2) netpol-rotation playbook, (3) add egress test simulating vendor IP changes. PM ticket PM-2026-92 assigned. Closing thread when 1h stable.
